## Appearance

Paul is a character with big, beautiful, dark blue eyes and delicate features. Though once small for his age with chestnut or brown curls, he later wears his hair in close-cropped brown locks. By thirteen years old, he has grown very tall for his years, eventually reaching a splendid six feet in height.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P11](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0011), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0029), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0030), +4 more_

## Personality

Paul Irving is a manly, clean, and highly imaginative boy who behaves as a perfect little gentleman. Recognized as a genius, he possesses dreams and fancies along with occasional flashes of uncanny insight.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P32](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0032), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P52](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0052), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P3](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0003), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P54](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0054)_

## History

Paul Irving, an imaginative student who lost his mother three years prior, cheered his new teacher, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), on her first day of school by gifting her wild orchids. He shared a close bond with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), often writing about and discussing his rich inner world, including imaginary shore friends, rock people, and childhood worries. Deeply distressed upon learning that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) was resigning from her teaching post to attend college, he accompanied her to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where he bonded with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) over their shared experiences with imaginary dream-people. After meeting his returning father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), Paul became excited to move to [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston) following his father's wedding to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). Years later, Paul returned as a guest to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to celebrate Anne's wedding to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P20](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0020), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043), +35 more_

## Quotes

> "and I came back to give them to you because I thought you were the kind of lady that would like them, and because . . ."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021)

> “Yes; but if dryads are foolish they must take the consequences, just as if they were real people,” said Paul gravely. “Do you know what I think about the new moon, teacher? I think it is a little golden boat full of dreams.”
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P30](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0030)

> "I’ve eaten enough to make anyone grow. I do hope, now that I’ve begun, I’ll keep on till I’m as tall as father. He is six feet, you know, Miss Lavendar."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P24](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0024)

> "I think you would make a splendid mother. You have just the right look in your eyes . . . the look my little mother always had. I think it’s a pity you haven’t any boys of your own."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P58](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0058)

> "you can’t think what has happened! Something so splendid. Father is here . . . just think of that! Father is here! Come right in. Father, this is my beautiful teacher. You know, father."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--paul-irving.md)

Paul is a pupil at [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's school, and the two quickly become fast friends over their shared imaginative thoughts. He frequently walks with her, shares his childhood worries, gifts her wild orchids, and spent time together in conversation. When news spreads of Anne's resignation and upcoming departure to college, Paul is deeply distressed by the loss of his beloved teacher.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000), +14 more_

### [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--paul-irving.md)

[Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) views Paul as a rival, harboring feelings of hatred and envy toward him because of the praise [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) bestows upon Paul. While [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends time entertaining Paul's imaginative stories and having tea with him, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) struggles at home with his intense jealousy over their bond.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P2](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0002), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P23](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0023), +2 more_
